about: relay-v1 P3 with optional sell-through samples (0.6.0). Header field 8 (after the tokens) = dt in base 36, 600..7200 s: the scan carries samples for the interval (t - dt, t]. Then each token may have a fifth subfield: absent = 0 units sold, empty ('id:lo:qty:qty5:') = no sample for that item, base 36 = units sold (0..1000000). Without field 8 the message is exactly the 0.5.1 format. 0.4.x/0.5.x receivers accept these messages and ignore field 8 and the fifth subfields (their Parse allows extra lowercase-alphanumeric fields and subfields). Packing counts the '|dt' suffix in the 250-byte budget. Every part of one series carries the same dt; a receiver that sees parts with different dt keeps the prices and drops the samples.

edge060.why: dt below 600: samples dropped, prices kept
dt above 7200: samples dropped, prices kept
a fifth subfield above 1000000 drops only that item's sample
an eighth field with a capital letter: the whole message is refused (as in 0.4.0)
